text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of features often described as user stories. Every day, team members hold quick standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver small parts of the product regularly, get feedback, and improve continuously. As a result, Agile helps teams respond faster to change and work more efficiently together.
